title: Ban cap nhat v1.6.6 - Tich hop cot IP Public va chuc nang Check IP tren Form Login 2FA
releaseNotes:
- Bo sung cot 'IP Public' tren bang thiet bi Form Login 2FA
- Them nut 'Check IP' ngay canh tuy chon Check IP tren giao dien
- Them menu chuot phai: Check Public IP (May nay / Tat ca) va Vo hieu hoa IPv6 tren bang va man hinh dien thoai
- Dong bo co che check IP da endpoint, hien thi ma quoc gia nhu ben dang ky
